xrefs.text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.
You are not to make any gods alongside Me; you are not to make for yourselves gods of silver or gold.
All makers of idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses fail to see or comprehend, so they are put to shame.
